hero_section.subtitle: Eliminate Hallucinations with Context-Injected AI Infrastructure
hero_section.description: We engineer production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that anchor foundational large language models to your secure, internal company data stores. Convert vast, unstructured data silos into precise, real-time business intelligence.

introduction_section.heading: What is an Enterprise-Grade
content: At Devisgon, we design and implement advanced RAG architectures that provide language models with a secure, real-time factual baseline. Moving away from standard, hallucination-prone prompt engineering, our systems programmatically search, retrieve, and rank the exact context needed from your internal knowledge bases before any model response is generated.

We bridge the gap between static model weights and dynamic, evolving enterprise data lakes. Every RAG pipeline we deploy features automated document parsing, high-dimensional vector embeddings, hybrid semantic-keyword searching, and strict document-level access permissions, ensuring your answers are mathematically verified, current, and securely enclosed.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Zero-hallucination model outputs, real-time knowledge injection, 100% deterministic data boundaries.”

faq_section.title: RAG Architecture & FAQ
faq_section.subtitle: Clear answers to critical implementation, security, and systems engineering queries

questions.question: Why is a hybrid search system necessary for enterprise-grade RAG?
questions.answer: Dense vector search is exceptional at grasping conceptual semantic intent, but it can miss specific serial keys, product codes, or exact names. Hybrid search blends vector embeddings with traditional keyword tracking (BM25) to guarantee both structural and conceptual matching accuracy.

questions.question: How does a RAG system keep its data current as our business records change daily?
questions.answer: We establish automated event webhooks and Cron sync schedules. Whenever a document is modified, added, or deleted inside your storage platform, our pipeline instantly runs extraction, generates fresh embeddings, and updates your vector database index automatically.

questions.question: How do you protect sensitive data from being shown to employees without proper credentials?
questions.answer: We enforce strict metadata permission tagging at the database level. Every document block is vectorized alongside its required access roles; when a user issues a query, the system appends a hard verification filter, making unauthorized files mathematically invisible to the lookup step.

questions.question: What tools do you use to evaluate and score the accuracy of a RAG pipeline?
questions.answer: We integrate automated evaluation frameworks like RAGAS and TruLens during sandbox development. We continuously test and optimize for three distinct metrics: Faithfulness (is the answer based on data?), Answer Relevance (does it solve the prompt?), and Context Precision (did we pull the right data chunks?).
